app.demoTitle: Review parser output with a clearer path from intake to sign-off.
app.demoLead: Start with a sample skill, inspect parser mode, run reviewer-facing checks, and export a review package without needing a multi-user backend or canonical-equivalence overclaims.
app.demoFeatureModeBody: Make canonical versus standalone mode visible before anyone treats exported artifacts as final evidence.
app.demoFeatureFlowBody: Move from intake to validation, notes, summary, sign-off, and export in one continuous workspace.
app.demoFeatureExportBody: Generate a dedicated review report alongside `.skill.md` and SkillDocument JSON exports.
app.demoPathLead: The public demo should feel obvious within a few minutes. These steps mirror the intended external-review narrative.
app.demoPathSampleBody: Load the bundled example first so reviewers can see the full parser and review workflow before bringing their own input.
app.demoPathImportTitle: Import or paste your own skill
app.demoPathImportBody: Bring in `SKILL.md`, SkillDocument JSON, or a bundled context set once you understand the review surface and parser mode labels.
app.demoPathReviewBody: Run checks, add notes, fill in summary and sign-off gates, then export the dedicated review report for external sharing.
app.demoDocsTitle: Go from quick start to implementation detail
app.demoDocsLead: The landing flow should send newcomers to the right document instead of forcing them to reverse-engineer the whole repository.
app.demoDocsIndexBody: Use the structured docs map when you need the full architecture, module breakdown, and chaptered review package.
app.demoDocsDeployBody: Understand environment variables, runtime modes, hosting constraints, and the recommended standalone deployment profile.
app.demoDocsPlanBody: Read the current demo brief for audience, narrative, page structure, and next implementation slices.
app.demoScenariosTitle: Open a demo flow that matches the review story you need
app.demoScenariosLead: These sample scenarios are safe to share publicly and are designed to highlight different review surfaces without depending on private customer data.

bundle-review.focus: bundle review, supporting file resolution, and manifest-oriented findings

publish-gate.title: Publish approval gate
publish-gate.body: Walk through a release approval scenario that emphasizes reviewer summary, sign-off gates, and evidence before allowing external publish commands.
publish-gate.focus: release sign-off, reviewer checklist, and export readiness

app.demoWhyTitle: Parser output needs a reviewer workflow around it
app.demoWhyLead: The public demo should explain why this product exists, not just expose a parser result dump.
app.demoWhyParserTitle: Parser output alone is not the product
app.demoWhyParserBody: A parsed SkillDocument is useful, but reviewers still need visible mode, validation, consistency, and context before calling it evidence.
app.demoWhyEvidenceBody: The workflow adds notes, diff review, test evidence, summary, and sign-off so external reviewers can see how a conclusion was reached.
app.demoWhyDocsTitle: Newcomers need a guided reading path
app.demoWhyDocsBody: The landing surface should hand off to the right docs instead of assuming new contributors can infer architecture and deployment posture on their own.
app.demoTrustTitle: Keep the demo honest about what it proves
app.demoTrustLead: The public standalone demo is useful because it is explicit about parser mode, equivalence limits, and what still needs canonical review.
app.demoTrustModeBody: Reviewers can see whether they are looking at canonical bridge output or a standalone compatibility pass before exporting or approving anything.
app.demoTrustEquivalenceTitle: Standalone is framed as compatibility, not proof
app.demoTrustEquivalenceBody: The landing narrative should state that standalone mode is for accessibility and public demos, while strict equivalence decisions still belong to canonical review.
app.demoTrustDraftBody: Draft recovery is browser-local convenience. It is not shared review history, multi-user collaboration, or durable backend storage.
app.demoTrustLinkLabel: Read the mode and equivalence contract
app.demoArtifactsTitle: Show what a reviewer can actually take away
app.demoArtifactsLead: A good demo ends with concrete artifacts that external reviewers can inspect, export, and compare against deeper documentation.
app.demoArtifactReportBody: Export a reviewer-facing markdown report with notes, checks, summary, sign-off state, and decision log for external review packets.
app.demoArtifactJsonBody: Keep the structured parser projection available for validation, consistency checks, editor workflows, and downstream inspection.
app.demoArtifactSkillBody: Bridge the structured review back to a shareable skill-style export so reviewers can compare human-readable output with the structured projection.
app.demoArtifactExampleReportBody: A public-safe example of the reviewer-facing export: mode, status, gates, and summary are all visible before sign-off leaves the browser.
app.demoArtifactExampleReportSnippet:
## Review Summary
- Parser mode: standalone
- Review status: in_review
- Validation gate: pass
- Diff reviewed: yes

## Reviewer Notes
- Confirm bundle references before final approval.
app.demoArtifactExampleJsonBody: A compact structured projection preview that makes downstream validation and consistency checks legible without exposing private source content.
app.demoArtifactExampleSkillBody: A skill-style export preview that helps reviewers compare the human-readable artifact against the structured SkillDocument projection.
app.demoArtifactExampleSkillSnippet:
# Demo-safe Export

## Workflow
- Review supporting files
- Record reviewer notes
- Export report after sign-off

## Rules
- Never approve unresolved references
- Always capture reviewer summary

app.emptyTitle: A ternary classification system for parsing the internal structure of Claude Skills and MCP Tools
app.emptyLead: Upload a SKILL definition, paste a draft, or test a parser scenario. The workspace is designed to make flow, security posture, and execution trace feel legible at a glance.
app.emptyFeatureFlowBody: Follow phases, decision nodes, and hand-offs in one continuous visual lane.
app.emptyFeatureMatrixBody: See compliance pressure, findings, and classification weight without leaving the main workspace.
app.emptyFeatureTraceBody: Keep parser evidence, source links, and editor adjustments visible as part of the same tool.
app.inputGuide: Paste a SKILL.md excerpt, a SkillDocument JSON payload, a parser scenario, or a URL payload to generate a richer analytical workspace.
app.inputDrop: Drop a primary SKILL file or SkillDocument JSON here. Additional JSON/YAML/TXT files stay as context when they are not valid imports.
app.workspaceHint: Use the sample to preview the strengthened layout and motion system.
app.bridgeGuidanceCanonical: This review is using the canonical skill-0 bridge. Parser output is suitable for final equivalence review as long as the supporting files and findings are still inspected.
app.bridgeGuidanceStandalone: This review is using the standalone fallback parser. Treat the result as a compatibility preview and re-run it through the canonical skill-0 bridge before making a final equivalence decision.
app.bridgeGuidanceUnavailable: Parser mode could not be verified yet. Confirm bridge status before exporting or approving this review result.
app.reviewNotesPlaceholder: Capture approval rationale, follow-up work, or blockers for the next reviewer.
app.reviewPacketHint: Capture the reviewer decision before exporting. The review packet keeps parser mode, equivalence framing, and reviewer notes together.
app.validationNoIssues: No schema or consistency issues are currently blocking this review snapshot.
app.validationUnavailable: Validation evidence is not available for this review snapshot yet.
app.validationMissingSchemaVersion: Missing schema version in the imported or current SkillDocument payload.
app.validationMissingSkillId: Missing skill_id in the current SkillDocument payload.
app.validationMissingTitle: Missing title or name in the current SkillDocument payload.
app.validationEmptyDecomposition: The current SkillDocument payload has no actions, rules, or directives.
app.validationMissingStepReference: Execution path references an element that is not present in the decomposition.
app.validationMissingExecutionPaths: No execution paths were emitted for the current review snapshot.
app.validationImportedJsonWarning: This review was restored from a SkillDocument JSON import. Re-run the canonical bridge before final approval.
app.validationStandaloneWarning: This review is using the standalone fallback parser. Treat schema evidence as provisional until the canonical bridge is re-run.
app.validationNoIssues: No schema issues were detected for the current SkillDocument projection.
app.consistencyNoIssues: No consistency issues were detected for the current SkillDocument projection.
app.reviewDecisionLogEmpty: No reviewer decisions have been captured yet.
app.reviewChecklistModeConfirmed: Parser mode and equivalence wording confirmed
app.reviewChecklistEvidenceReady: Evidence package ready for external review
app.reviewSummaryPlaceholder: Write the final reviewer summary, approval caveats, or explicit sign-off rationale...
app.reviewerNotesIdle: No session notes have been captured yet. Add a global note or pin a note to a specific action, rule, or directive.
app.reviewerNotesPlaceholder: Capture reviewer context, sign-off concerns, or follow-up actions...
app.diffSummaryUnavailable: Diff summary is unavailable until both an original and current SkillDocument projection exist.
app.reviewerTestsIdle: No reviewer-facing test actions have been run yet. Trigger validation, consistency, or a simple path walk to create a review history.

vector.title: Semantic Vector Space
vector.subtitle: Skill clustering based on intent and operability
vector.analysisDesc: The skill is positioned in the <1>High Operability, Moderate Risk</1> quadrant. It shares semantic similarities with data extraction and transformation pipelines.
vector.semanticMapDesc: Start with the lightweight review map to inspect structure, density, and phase relationships. Open 3D only when spatial exploration adds value.
vector.mapReviewHint: Use the review map first. It is faster, easier to scan, and better suited to reviewer workflows than forcing 3D by default.
vector.publicMode3dNote: This public build keeps the lightweight review map and omits the interactive 3D workspace to reduce payload size, GPU pressure, and device compatibility risk.
vector.rebuildRecommendation: Direct rebuild should stay selective: keep the parser workbench shell, but rebuild heavy or high-friction modules like VectorSpace, tokenized surfaces, and state boundaries incrementally.
vector.semanticVectorDesc: Visualizing the skill's tasks, inputs, and outputs as vector embeddings in a high-dimensional semantic space. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom.
